title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 149
description: Ten questions on Psalms 149: a new song in the assembly, praise with dance, and a two-edged sword in the saints' hand.

questions.text: Where should the new song of praise be sung?
questions.explanation: The psalm says, "Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints."

answers.text: On the walls of the city
In the assembly of the saints
In the courts of the king

questions.explanation: The psalm says, "Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King."

answers.text: In the covenant of the fathers
In the strength of their armies

questions.text: With which instruments should they sing praises, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: They are to praise his name in the dance and sing praises to him with tambourine and harp.

questions.text: With what does Yahweh crown the humble?
questions.explanation: The psalm says Yahweh takes pleasure in his people and crowns the humble with salvation.

questions.text: Where do the saints sing for joy?
questions.explanation: The psalm says, "Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds."

questions.text: What should be in the saints' hand while the high praises of God are in their mouths?
questions.explanation: The psalm says, "May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand."

questions.text: What are the saints to execute on the nations?
questions.explanation: They are to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples.

questions.text: With what are the nobles to be bound?
questions.explanation: The psalm speaks of binding their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron.

questions.text: What judgment are the saints to execute on the kings and nobles?
questions.explanation: They are to execute on them the written judgment.

questions.text: Who has the honor described at the end of the psalm?
questions.explanation: The psalm ends, "All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!"
